en: Color postcard view of a richly decorated Baroque pavilion and surrounding courtyard. The central building has large arched windows, elaborate sculptures and reliefs, and a mansard-style roof. Curved colonnades extend from both sides, enclosing an oval forecourt with terraced steps and rows of benches, suggesting it may be used as an open‑air venue. Trees form a green backdrop behind the ornate stone architecture. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the front.
